channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: When my girlfriend said she was leaving because of my obsession with The Monkees, I thought she was joking.
item.description:
When my girlfriend said she was leaving because of my obsession with The Monkees, I thought she was joking.
And then I saw her face...

item.title: Y'all heard about the reverse exorcism the other day?
item.description:
Y'all heard about the reverse exorcism the other day?
The devil was trying to pull the priest out of a little boy.

item.title: A woman visits her husband in prison. Before leaving, she says to a correction officer: "You shouldn't make my husband work so hard he's exhausted!" The officer laughs: "Work? Ma'am, he only eats, sleeps, and stays in his cell."
item.description:
A woman visits her husband in prison. Before leaving, she says to a correction officer: "You shouldn't make my husband work so hard he's exhausted!" The officer laughs: "Work? Ma'am, he only eats, sleeps, and stays in his cell."
The wife replies: "That's strange. He told me he's been digging a tunnel for months!"

item.title: Where do lizards go after their tail falls off?
item.description:
Where do lizards go after their tail falls off?
The retail store.

item.title: How are slutty cows shipped into the US?
item.description:
How are slutty cows shipped into the US?
Through the Strait of Whore Moos.

item.title: Why didn't Noah fish when he was on the Ark?
item.description:
Why didn't Noah fish when he was on the Ark?
Because he only had two worms.

item.title: When is a door not a door?
item.description:
When is a door not a door?
When it is ajar.

item.title: Light travels faster than sound.
item.description:
Light travels faster than sound.
That's why some people appear bright until you hear them speak.

item.title: What starts with the letter 'F' and ends in 'uck'?
item.description:
What starts with the letter 'F' and ends in 'uck'?
Firetruck.

item.title: My 5 year old nephew came up to me with an outstretched hand holding an acorn. "Uncle, what's this?" he asks.
item.description:
My 5 year old nephew came up to me with an outstretched hand holding an acorn. "Uncle, what's this?" he asks.
"That? That's a tree!" I replied "This is a tree?" he asks with a wrinkled look. "Yeah, in a nutshell!" I said.
